Hi Michael, Jon Clark here. I saw your listing for the 2016 Nissan Altima with 83,223 miles. I’m interested in taking it off your hands, but I have to be direct: your asking price of $12,600 is above the KBB private-party estimate, which sits around $11,765 for this vehicle in a standard condition.

Before I lock in a formal offer, I need to know the mechanical history. With this model year, the CVT transmission is a major concern, so I have to ask: has it been serviced, flushed, or replaced? Are there any current drivability issues, pending repairs, leaks, or warning lights on the dash? And do you have full maintenance records?

I’ll be upfront with my position so we don’t waste each other’s time. Given the current market data, I’m anchoring my budget at **$10,500**. If there are any documented defects or upcoming repairs needed, my offer would need to come down by the full cost of those fixes. Let me know where things stand mechanically and we can go from there.
